title: Vintage Sewing Machine Quilter T-Shirt

description:
The Vintage Sewing Machine tee — a classic engraving-style illustration of an antique cast-iron sewing machine with thread, scissors, and a pincushion, made for quilters, sewists, and anyone who loves making things by hand.

Printed on a Comfort Colors 1717 heavyweight tee — 100% ring-spun cotton, garment-dyed for a soft, vintage feel and a relaxed fit that gets better with every wash.

Sizing:

This shirt runs relaxed and oversized. Order your usual size for a relaxed look, or size down for a more fitted feel.
